title: Pentax unplug frees a NULL local instead of the allocated private state
description:
Severity low; confidence high; resource ownership. indigo_drivers/ccd_pentax/indigo_ccd_pentax.c:1138-1149 initializes private_data=NULL and never assigns it; after detaching/unref it frees that NULL and frees only the device. Allocation at1113 remains leaked on every unplug and driver shutdown routed through unplug. Minimal fix: capture device->private_data before detach and free that captured allocation exactly once; fake repeated attach/unplug ownership check. No matching active finding identified. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-10). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
